notes.title: 40% OFF + update v. 1.01!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31951084/40d6a02a1313fbc8101cc87a2c544c2dd8c517a7.jpg

As you know, we're still polishing the game. 
In the final phase of working on the game, we turned up the playability. 
The Invisibility power grants the player a new form of control, new ways to interact with enemies - for the duration of the power they become immobilized - like stone statues. 
And it gives more choice! You can use invulnerability and pass through the enemy, but sometimes it’s more effective to jump over them or find a gap to move through.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31951084/70d435e6bee397c9850ef77117cfe159f5433bc6.gif

We tested this feature and wondered if it isn’t too revolutionary for Haxor, but that’s what makes this game such great fun, and in the last phase of development we marked the checkbox in the code: active special power! 
See how fun it is for yourselves!

On this occasion, Haxor is 40% OFF now! 
Enjoy!

FULL CHANGELOG:
 The Invisible power now has a special addon - the enemies are frozen for the duration of the power.
 Fixed Fulgur Dragon Boss - Head was not immortal in the first and second phase.
 You can now jump on monster eggs to destroy them.
 Fixed some level design issues.
 Fixed some typos.
 Life now restores on each level.
 Corrections in the amount of enemies HP.
 Fixed Fulgur Hydra Boss
 Save Reset Screen Fixed


and....
↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A Start
You know what to do with this ;)

notes.title: Haxor update is very close now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31951084/8dfae4c7c573d649eee0f8b086a56b885b08e287.jpg

We're getting closer to the first major update of the game! We're polishing and balancing things to make Haxor even more fun and make sure you get the best experience possible. 

But that's not all! We're also changing how some gameplay mechanics work. Stay tuned for next updates - patch is on the way!

notes.title: Release date announced!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31951084/6c1878b9a78f8ea40a39d88160c4458f2b0e7603.png

Haxor will be released on 12.04.2019!

The game will include 4 great worlds to explore, many special abilities to use and plenty of monsters to kill, with outstanding bosses in the end of each level! Wishlist now to get the information on the release date and return back to these good, old times of gaming!
